summary: Build a clean, modern 2-page marketing website for a web design agency (Webraft) targeting local businesses in India, with a warm/professional premium style and a Home + Pricing page.
architectural_notes: Design direction: warm, professional, trustworthy, modern; lots of whitespace; strong typography hierarchy; deep blue/purple gradient accents on clean white backgrounds; soft shadows and subtle rounded corners.

Home page sections: Hero (headline, subheadline, 2 CTAs, laptop mockup, gradient background), Why Website Matters (2x2 icon cards), Services (4–5 icon feature blocks), Process (horizontal 4 steps), Final centered CTA.
Pricing page: 3 vertical pricing cards centered; middle plan visually highlighted as 'Most Popular'; each plan has 'Get Started' CTA.
Add a WhatsApp CTA button (wa.me deep link) that opens direct chat to +91 8780410844, and surface phone/WhatsApp + email contact details on the site.

existing_features.title: Create a 2-page marketing website for the web design agency named "webraft" with routes/pages for Home and Pricing, including clear navigation between them (e.g., header nav links and CTA links).

Implement the Home page layout with the following sections in order, matching the provided copy and layout constraints: (1) Hero with left text + two CTA buttons and right-side laptop mockup image; (2) Why a Website Matters section with heading, short paragraph, and a 2x2 grid of icon cards; (3) Services/What We Provide with heading and 4–5 minimal feature cards with icons; (4) Our Process with heading and a horizontal 4-step numbered indicator; (5) Final Call To Action section with centered headline and one strong CTA.

Implement the Pricing page with three centered vertical pricing cards and the exact plan names, prices, included items, and maintenance/hosting notes as provided; visually highlight the middle plan as "Most Popular" and add a "Get Started" CTA button under each plan.

Apply the specified visual design system site-wide: warm, premium-but-approachable modern feel with lots of white space, strong typography hierarchy, modern sans-serif typography, soft shadows, subtle rounded corners, consistent accent color usage, and a deep blue + purple gradient used in hero/background accents with clean white background sections.

Wire the CTA interactions: "View Pricing" navigates to the Pricing page; "Book Free Consultation" navigates to a consultation/contact section on the Home page (or opens an on-page consultation panel) without requiring backend persistence.

Add and use professional website mockup imagery in the Home hero (modern laptop mockup showing a website) and a subtle abstract gradient background treatment behind the hero (smooth abstract shapes). Store generated images as static assets and reference them directly from the frontend.
Update the consultation/contact section to display the provided phone number and email address, replacing the current placeholder phone number and existing email text.
Add a clickable WhatsApp CTA button that opens a direct WhatsApp chat to the number 918780410844 using a standard WhatsApp deep link, so users can click and start chatting immediately.
Make the WhatsApp contact area in the consultation/contact section actionable by linking it to the same WhatsApp direct chat URL for 918780410844.

Update the site footer contact area to include the provided phone number and email address (and optionally include a WhatsApp chat link) so the contact details are visible outside the consultation section as well.
